title: Broken Earth
description: A datapack that turns the normal minecraft world into a fractured landscape. Also adds a new dimension.
body:
**The Broken Earth**

A datapack that turns the normal overworld of minecraft into a fractured dystopian landscape.
![Broken Earth](https://i.ibb.co/1GPJc48G/2025-06-16-15-39-30.png)
This datapack also adds a custom dimension, if the overworld is too modified for your liking.
To get there, run the command: **/execute in qcraft:dim1 run tp @s 0 200 0**
![Dim1](https://i.ibb.co/mrQft4j8/2025-06-16-15-41-31.png)
It also adds another dimension, which is at the moment a copy of the overworld, but in time it will become a different dimension.
The Command to get there is: **/execute in aether:aether run tp @s 0 100 0**
